Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: auction theory | ID: 17350

Assertion

If X is a metric space and T: X -> X is a continuous operator, then T admits a unique decomposition T = D + N where D is diagonalizable and N is nilpotent.

Proof

Step 1. Applying the unitary interpolation theorem to \(V_{01330011}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 2. Consider the meromorphic operator \(V_{01330012}\) acting on the Fock space. By the meromorphic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|V_{01330012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01330012\).

Step 3. By the subharmonic spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the subharmonic spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the iterative convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
